Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning requests made by a party relating to gas or electrical company discounts for low income senior customers and lowincome customers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requests made by a party concerning gas orelectrical company discounts for lowincome senior customers and lowincome customers; and amending RCW 80.28.068.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 80.28.068 and 1999 c 62 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon request by an electrical or gas company, or a party, thecommission may approve rates, charges, services, and/or physicalfacilities at a discount for lowincome senior customers and lowincomecustomers. Expenses and lost revenues as a result of these discountsshall be included in the company's cost of service and recovered inrates to other customers.
